Builders Module#

The builders module provides the core functionality for constructing atomistic systems. It acts as a high-level interface to generate crystalline surfaces, aqueous solutions, and complex interfaces suitable for LAMMPS simulations.

System Construction#

Functions for creating bulk structures and liquid environments.

cemd.builders.hydrates.pycsh

Create a C-S-H model or a list of C-S-H models as LAMMPSData using the pyCSH code (see https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconres.2024.107593).

cemd.builders.hydrates.build_csh

Create a C-S-H supercell.

cemd.builders.base.build_solution

Generate an AtomicSystem representing a liquid solution using Packmol.

cemd.builders.base.build_glass

Create an atomic system of glass from a composition of oxides or molecules.

Interface Generation#

Tools for combining solid surfaces with liquid phases or droplets.

cemd.builders.base.add_structure

Add a structure to a solid surface at a given distance.

cemd.builders.base.add_liquid

Create a solid/liquid interface by generating a liquid block.

cemd.builders.base.add_droplet

Add a hemispherical liquid droplet onto a solid surface.

cemd.builders.base.build_surface

Generate crystalline surfaces from a given structure.

Structural Refinement#

Utilities to repair or modify atomic frameworks (e.g., silanol group addition).

cemd.builders.base.rebuild_silicates

Rebuild the coordination of Si atoms with coordination < 4 by adding silanol (OH) groups.

cemd.builders.base.protonate

Add a proton (hydrogen atom) to a specific atom in the system.

cemd.builders.base.merge

Merge two AtomicSystem objects and handle topology updates.

cemd.builders.base.split

Split an AtomicSystem into two parts along a specified axis.
